description.en: Its distinguishing construction is low flapped body, five eye stalks and one long claw-ended proboscis; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant. Original stylized teaching art. Palette, nominal size, pose and simplified details are artistic choices; no scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
description.zh: 以低矮侧叶身体、五枚眼柄与末端带爪的长吻为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。 原创风格化教学道具；配色、标称尺寸、姿态及简化细节是美术选择，非严格科学或同域共存复原。
